nodes.title: When you've selected which Sample Preview to upscale, enable the below toggle\nthen continue right ->

Start your upscale by clicking the below button. If you don't like the result, you can reroll\nby clicking the button as many times as you like to get variations of the first pass! (Unless\nyou change something like prompt, resolution, refs, ANYTHING that happened before this step)
Start new gens by making sure 'Enable Final Pass' is\nturned off then click Manual Random Seed button below
After the First Pass Sample Previews all finish, select which of\nthe finished previews looks best below (Make sure only 1 is selected). Then continue right ->

1. Turn both it & Single Pass ON in the Options.
2. Load your video in the Video 1 slot and click the yellow Scissors icon.
   - the left side (beginning) is where your video will start after being stitched together.
   - the right side (end) is where your gen will continue from.
   (IDEALLY your video is 24 FPS and already the correct size/aspect ratio,
   as mismatched video can result in imperfect continuations! Use Crop tool to resize.)
3. Select Overlap Frames (5, 22, 39, or 56). This is the # of frames Minimax
     has access to as reference for how to continue your video.
4. If your video has no audio, turn on the OG Vid Has No Audio option to the right.
5. Since this is Single Pass, change your video genning settings:
   - Steps: 6-10+
   - Increase megapixels to 0.8-1.5
   - Turn off Previews #2 and #3
   - Turn off Final Upscale Pass
6. Prompt! Remember that the first 5-39 frames of your gen are SPOKEN FOR!
   In order to get seamless continuation, start with
   "a continuous shot from beginning to end" and then describe what's happening
   in a way that the model will understand how it can continue the shot.

Seamless Video Continuation is for changing existing videos, and for creating
single-take shots longer than 15s. It is not a replacement for video editing, and if you
can get away with cuts then just use normal genning practices with references to your
previous shots/scenes.

The more overlap frames, the slower the gen (go figure).

widgets_values:
This is your prompting area. Click Sections -> Add Missing to get a blank template.
Type < to get a dropdown of common symbols such as <Picture 1> <Subject 1> <Audio 1> , etc. >

By default, the workflow is set up in Seed Hunter mode:
- Generates 1-3 sample previews at low resolution. After finishing, select which one you liked best, turn on Upscale Pass toggle, and then run the WF again. If you didn't change anything that would make stage 1 regenerate (and don't have "--no-cache" startup flag for comfy), your selected stage 1 will pass to the upscaler and then finalize.

Video Continuation mode:
- Seamlessly continues previously existing videos and then stitches them together. See below documentation (white group underneath this node).

This workflow comes with my default recommended settings. Dareties Turbo LoRA is the best of them all in my opinion, and for Seed Hunting I recommend 6 steps at 0.3-0.5 MP first pass, 4 steps at 1.0-2.0 MP upscale pass.
For very high quality production, I recommend using Single Pass mode, running 6-8 steps at 1.5-2.0 MP straight through. Upscaling has its costs, and single pass will always produce higher quality output.
